feature interface-vlan

username admin password 5 $5$FAKEsalt$nxosAdminType5HashAbCdEf role network-admin      ! cisco-password-type

  server 10.20.30.40

snmp-server user admin network-admin auth md5 0xFAKEauthMd5Hash1234 priv 0xFAKEprivHash5678 localizedkey   ! cisco-snmp-user
